name: OpenTUI
summary: Library for building terminal user interfaces in TypeScript, React or Solid on a native Zig renderer.
description: A terminal UI toolkit: a native Zig core with TypeScript bindings renders a component tree, lays it out with Flexbox (Yoga) and updates only the terminal cells that changed while handling keyboard input. Use @opentui/core imperatively, or @opentui/react and @opentui/solid; components include text, box, input, textarea, select, tab select, slider, scroll box, code and markdown. Ships an example browser and a skill that teaches AI agents the APIs.
contains: components: input, textarea, select, tab select, slider, scroll box, code, markdown, diff
native Zig renderer with TypeScript bindings; Flexbox (Yoga) layout
renders only changed terminal cells; handles keyboard input, colors, focus
example browser with release executables for macOS, Linux and Windows
ships a skill so AI coding agents learn its APIs
